verdict.rationale: The managed service supports the Kafka table engine and materialized views 'as documented' (docs-36), so the service itself can continuously consume event streams without separate pipeline workers. CHKit mentions deploying 'pipelines as code' (docs-11). However, the user must still supply a Kafka source, and s3()/url() are one-shot table functions rather than continuous file watchers. missing for 10: a documented managed continuous file-ingestion capability (auto-ingest on file arrival), a managed connector/ingest service that needs no user-run broker, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
